title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：tobacco　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tobacco 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower ① grew the tobacco that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured, and he said the growing was the whole of the summer. The ② tobacco, meaning the leaf itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed unmeasured in the book; tobacco, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of tobacco in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ tobacco at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Tobacco, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grower said the measuring is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tobacco was the whole of the matter, meaning the habit and not the leaf. The ⑥ tobacco, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; tobacco, he said, is either something you grow or the only word that means both leaf and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ tobacco had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ tobacco of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of measuring; tobacco, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tobacco I remember is the tobacco measured in the ledger, which closed in 1996 and is still measured as the quietest in the greenhouse. ⑩ Tobacco, my mother said in 1998, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all tobacco, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like leaf. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 烟草（指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 烟草（指那片烟草本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow the tobacco 种这一片烟草
D. n. 烟草（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 烟草之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的烟草之事）
F. n. 烟草（指收成账里写到、被测量的那一片）
G. n. 烟草、嗜好（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 嗜好（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: grew the tobacco that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured
The tobacco, meaning the leaf itself and not the crate
Every sort of tobacco in that greenhouse
the tobacco at the far shelf
the tobacco was the whole of the matter
the tobacco had become a line in a ledger
The tobacco of the whole thing

answers.why: grow the tobacco 意为“种这一片烟草”，1989 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯测量的一片烟草做了一遍。
tobacco 意为“烟草”，指那片烟草本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被测量。
tobacco 意为“烟草”，指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
tobacco 意为“烟草”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tobacco 意为“烟草、嗜好”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片嗜好就是那件事的全部。
tobacco 意为“嗜好”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片烟草，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tobacco 意为“烟草”，指收成账里写到、被测量的那一片，到 1994 年这一片成了收成账里的一行。
tobacco 意为“烟草之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的烟草之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的测量。
tobacco 意为“烟草”，我记得的是收成账里测量过的那一片，1996 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一片。
tobacco 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，烟草是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的烟草。
